publications.title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Large Language Models: Evolution, Architectures, Applications, and Challenges (2020–2025)
publications.publisher: Wiley · WIREs Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery
publications.summary: A PRISMA-guided review of 91 studies on RAG evolution, architectures, retrieval and reranking, faithfulness, robustness, security, governance, and open research challenges.

publications.title: AI-Driven Knowledge Retrieval for Medical Question-Answering Using Large Language Models and Retrieval-Augmented Generation
